rationale: First direct check for the accepted obligation c-adopted-term-never-regresses (unit unit-c-adopted-term-never-regresses). It fixes one discriminator for the investigated premise: can a heartbeat-shaped AppendEntries that Raft.processHeartbeat handles on a NetworkTransport connection goroutine establish a lower adopted term than a term the same node's main goroutine has already adopted and reported. The harness uses the captured NetworkTransport (with a substituted socket-free StreamLayer) so the heartbeat classification and the off-main-goroutine callback dispatch are the target's own code, holds exactly one StableStore CurrentTerm write to open the read-compare-write interval, and reads the resulting term context from Raft.CurrentTerm and the durable CurrentTerm value. The plan records the equality-encoding scope limit and the substitution explicitly, and the execution does not show the downstream vote consequence.
